name: Mây Concept - Thảo Điền
tagline: A beautifully curated concept store for minimalist home décor, gifts and lifestyle pieces.
notes: Known for Scandinavian and Japandi-inspired homewares, ceramics, fragrances and thoughtfully designed gifts.

name: Forward Perfume
tagline: A niche fragrance boutique specialising in unique perfumes and personalised scent discoveries.
notes: Carries a curated collection of niche and independent fragrance brands with knowledgeable staff.

name: Gia Perfumerie Saigon
tagline: A premium perfume boutique offering an impressive collection of luxury and niche fragrances.
notes: One of Saigon's best-known destinations for authentic designer and niche perfumes.

name: ANNORA PERFUME HOUSE
tagline: A trusted perfume house offering authentic designer fragrances and personalised recommendations.
notes: Specialises in genuine luxury perfumes with an extensive collection for both men and women.

name: Scentury Concept
tagline: A refined concept store blending niche fragrances with elegant lifestyle products.
notes: Offers luxury niche perfumes alongside premium home fragrances and curated lifestyle products.

name: TOOUCH PERFUME & CANDLE/DIFFUSER
tagline: A boutique specialising in handcrafted perfumes, candles and premium home fragrances.
district: Tân Sơn Hòa, Tân Bình District
notes: Known for bespoke fragrances, scented candles and diffusers with a modern minimalist aesthetic.

name: MASSAGE HẠ SPA QUẬN 1
tagline: A popular District 1 massage spa offering affordable full-body treatments in a relaxed setting.
notes: Offers traditional Vietnamese massage, hot stone massage, foot reflexology and body treatments. A convenient option close to Bui Vien and District 1 attractions.

name: Sả Spa & Onsen
tagline: A modern Japanese-inspired wellness retreat featuring private onsen baths and premium spa treatments.
notes: Offers Japanese-style onsen experiences, massages, facials and body treatments in a tranquil, luxury setting.

name: The New Playground
tagline: A hidden underground hub featuring independent fashion, streetwear, cafés and Saigon's creative youth culture.
notes: A unique underground shopping destination beneath an old apartment building, popular for local brands, fashion, photography and creative experiences.

name: Nomad Perfumery
tagline: A niche fragrance boutique in Thao Dien offering unique scents and personalised perfume discoveries.
notes: A boutique perfumery focused on curated fragrances, premium scents and a personalised shopping experience.

name: NOI Space
tagline: A creative lifestyle space combining design, art, fashion and local creativity.
notes: A curated concept space featuring Vietnamese designers, handmade products and creative lifestyle items.

name: Forward Perfume
tagline: A modern fragrance boutique offering unique perfumes and personalised scent experiences.
notes: A niche fragrance store specialising in curated perfumes and premium scents.

name: R PARFUMS
tagline: A niche perfume boutique in Thao Dien offering curated luxury fragrances.
notes: A boutique fragrance store popular for premium perfumes and personalised recommendations.

name: Airy Workshop
tagline: A quirky gift shop filled with cute handmade items, stickers, accessories and creations from Vietnamese artists.
notes: A fun stop for unique Vietnamese-designed gifts, handmade goods and quirky souvenirs. Products include artist-designed items, stickers, charms and home décor. [oai_citation:0‡airyworkshop.info](https://airyworkshop.info/pages/about-us?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

name: Paradise4saigon
tagline: A curated fashion boutique showcasing unique streetwear and contemporary Vietnamese style.
notes: A boutique clothing store popular for fashion pieces with a strong individual style and creative identity.

name: LIDER 02 COMMONS
tagline: A creative fashion space in Thao Dien featuring curated clothing and lifestyle pieces.
notes: A boutique fashion destination located in the Thao Dien area, ideal for discovering independent styles and unique pieces.

name: 11 Garmentory
tagline: A curated fashion space showcasing unique local designers, contemporary clothing and Vietnamese creativity.
notes: A boutique fashion destination featuring carefully selected Vietnamese brands and modern streetwear pieces.

name: The New Playground
tagline: A hidden underground hub with independent fashion brands, streetwear, cafés and a youthful Saigon vibe.
notes: A unique underground shopping complex beneath an old apartment building, popular with younger locals for fashion, street culture and photography.

name: Bremiere Wellness Center
tagline: A five-star hotel spa offering premium massages, facials and wellness treatments.
notes: Located inside the JW Marriott Hotel & Suites Saigon.

name: Lang Spa
tagline: A hidden Thao Dien favourite for relaxing massages at excellent value.
notes: Known for friendly therapists and a calm atmosphere.

name: Massage Hạ Spa Quận 1
tagline: Affordable therapeutic massages just minutes from Ben Thanh Market.
notes: Popular for traditional Vietnamese and hot stone massages.

name: Spa Bar
tagline: Fruit & vegetable facials, cream massage and a jacuzzi — a proper pamper in Thao Dien.
notes: Already in your food list — pulled across here too.

name: Mia Saigon - Luxury Boutique Hotel
tagline: Riverside boutique hotel with a renowned spa and the best pool in Thao Dien.
notes: Also in your food list for the breakfast buffet.

name: Anan Spa Saigon
tagline: One of the most consistently rated day spas in D1 — the hot stone massage is the one to book.

name: Elisa Spa
tagline: Upscale spa in D3 — the deep tissue massage and facial packages are worth every dong.

name: Saigon Social Club Fitness
tagline: The expat gym of choice in Thao Dien — classes, weights, pool. Day passes available.

name: The Cloudest - Swim, Dine & Vibe
tagline: Pool day escape in Thu Duc — daypass, drinks and food. Mixed reviews on upkeep so check before going.
notes: Mixed reviews on upkeep — verify current state before visiting.

name: Lê Mai Store
tagline: Hand-poured candles and artisan soap — the most beautifully packaged gifts in Thao Dien.
notes: Already in your list.

name: Saigon Ink
tagline: The most reputable tattoo studio in Thao Dien — book ahead, walk-ins rarely get spots.

name: Ben Thanh Market
tagline: The city's most iconic market — touristy but worth one visit for the sheer scale of it.
notes: Bargain hard — initial prices are always inflated for tourists.

name: Vincom Center Đồng Khởi
tagline: The premium mall in D1 — international brands, good food court, and proper air con.

name: Thiso Mall Sala
tagline: The most pleasant mall in Thu Duc City — great food options, cinema, and far less crowded than D1.

name: Lumlaglasses - LLA CITY
tagline: Fashion eyewear boutique — unique frames you won't find in the mainstream chains.
notes: Already in your list.

name: Dan Sinh Market
tagline: The army surplus and hardware market — chaotic, fascinating, and full of genuine finds.
notes: Cash only, bargain expected.

name: La Poissonnerie
tagline: The Thao Dien mini-complex with boutique shops, a deli and restaurant in one charming space.
notes: Also in food list for the restaurant.

name: Bui Vien Walking Street
tagline: The chaotic, neon-drenched backpacker strip — loud, cheap, and an unmissable Saigon experience once.
notes: Best experienced on a Friday or Saturday night. Watch your belongings.

name: Blank Lounge Landmark 81
tagline: The highest bar in Vietnam — cocktails with a view that makes the price tag make sense.
district: Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City
notes: Also in your food list. Smart casual dress code enforced.

name: The Arth Saigon
tagline: Caviar, cocktails and a crowd that knows how to dress. D1's most theatrical night out.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: Ủ Bar
tagline: A hidden speakeasy in Tan Dinh with the 'Ủ Blossom' cocktail that people travel across the city for.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: Apocalypse Now
tagline: The Saigon nightclub that's been going since 1991 — an institution, rough around the edges, and genuinely fun.
notes: Open until 4am. Cash only at the door.

name: Lại La Modern Cocktail Club
tagline: Moody D1 cocktail bar with strong drinks and a low-lit atmosphere perfect for a late evening.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: Acoustic Bar Thao Dien
tagline: Cold beers and live acoustic sets in Thao Dien — the neighbourhood bar that never tries too hard.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: Kin Neko Dog & Cat Cafe
tagline: Matcha and Thai milk tea while cats and dogs roam around you — genuinely wholesome.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: War Remnants Museum
tagline: One of the most powerful museums in Southeast Asia — essential context for understanding modern Vietnam.
notes: Allow 2-3 hours. Not suitable for young children.

name: Reunification Palace
tagline: The building that defined the end of the Vietnam War — eerie, fascinating and frozen in 1975.
notes: Best with a guide or audio tour to understand the full history.

name: Fine Arts Museum
tagline: Three floors of Vietnamese art across a century in a beautiful colonial building — criminally undervisited.
notes: The OKKIO café is right next door for an after-visit coffee.

name: Saigon Opera House
tagline: A French colonial gem in D1 — AO Show and live performances that showcase Vietnamese artistry.
notes: Book tickets in advance. The AO Show is the most popular performance.

name: Trạm Hầm Thảo Điền
tagline: A Minecraft-themed underground grill in Thao Dien — genuinely fun for a group and the food holds up too.
notes: Also in your food list.

name: The Dao Teahouse
tagline: A no-phones, no-noise teahouse serving Dragon Claw tea — one of the most intentional spaces in Saigon.
notes: Also in your food list. No photos allowed inside.

name: Cu Chi Tunnels
tagline: 70km of underground tunnels used during the Vietnam War — a half-day trip that will stick with you.
district: Cu Chi District (day trip from HCMC)
notes: About 1.5 hours from the city centre. Ben Dinh site is less crowded than Ben Duoc.
